J1.A8: SBU1: not used by a USB-PD sink (Type-C spec: sideband use only) - open
J1.B8: SBU2: not used by a USB-PD sink - open
J3.6: VBREF: NC per N069 DS pin table 1.5 (reserved)
U1.10: GATE: open-drain PMOS driver, 'leave floating if unused' (DS table 1); not used because the _002 variant turns it on at POR
U1.2: D+: only for Apple/BC1.2 legacy detection (HUSB238 DS p.3, p.11); left open so the USB data pair stays free for the CH552 bootloader
U1.9: ISET: open = 3.25 A power-up request (DS table 7); I2C PDO select overrides VSET/ISET (DS p.11)
U4.12: P3.3: spare GPIO, internal pull-up by default - open
U4.13: P3.4: spare GPIO, internal pull-up by default - open
U4.2: P1.5: spare GPIO, internal pull-up by default - open. Kept free on purpose: P1.5 is the CH552 bootloader's alternate entry pin (pulled low at power-up), so nothing that can sit low at power-up goes on it
U4.7: RST: internal pull-down (CH552 DS section 4) - open
U5.1: A1 = GND: with A0 = GND the I2C address is 1000000b = 0x40 (INA226 DS table 6-2); clear of HUSB238 0x08 and OLED 0x3C
U5.3: ALERT: open-drain alert output, not used (firmware polls the registers) - open (INA226 DS table 4-1)
